title.text: Charles Bridge Canal Cruise with Drinks & Museum Entry

ratings.heading: Average of 2 booking sites, weighted by number of reviews

pills.label: Every 15 min
pills.pop_html: No fixed slot to plan around. Boats leave every 15 minutes from the pier at the Old Town end of Charles Bridge; daytime departures.Arrive, show the ticket, board the next boat.

pills.label: Drinks + snack
pills.pop_html: Included: a drink of beer, lemonade, tea or coffee (mulled wine in winter) plus traditional gingerbread, or ice cream in summer.One of only two cruises here where a drink is in the base price for under €25.

pills.label: Devil's Channel
pills.pop_html: A 45-minute loop under Charles Bridge into the Čertovka (Devil's Channel) on Kampa Island, past the Grand Priory Mill, then along the Malá Strana bank.Small wooden boats, so you sit close to the water.

pills.label: Museum ticket
pills.pop_html: Charles Bridge Museum entry included, next to the pier at Křižovnické náměstí. Use it before or after the cruise.

pills.label: 19-language audio
pills.pop_html: Audio commentary in 19 languages, on your own headphones.English, Spanish, German, French, Italian, Chinese, Japanese, Korean and more.

pills.label: Not step-free
pills.pop_html: ♿ Wheelchair: small open boats, not suitable for wheelchair users

best_for.pick_html: for a first hour on the water: drinks, gingerbread and a museum for €22.
best_for.skip_html: if you want views of Prague Castle at night: these are daytime boats.

items.q: Do I need to book a time?
items.a: No. Boats leave every 15 minutes in the daytime from the pier at the Old Town end of Charles Bridge: show your ticket and board the next one.
The cruise, a drink (beer, lemonade, tea or coffee, mulled wine in winter), gingerbread or ice cream in summer, Charles Bridge Museum entry and audio in 19 languages.
Křižovnické náměstí 3, Prague 1, at the Old Town end of Charles Bridge, next to the Charles Bridge Museum. Tram stop Karlovy lázně.

items.q: Does it run in the evening?
items.a: No, these are daytime boats. For the lit-up Castle, book the evening cruise (#2).
Yes, for free up to 24 hours before.

Yes: audio in Czech, English and German, a printed guide in 16 languages and an app in 13.

title.text: Jazz Boat: Live Jazz Cruise with Optional 3-Course Dinner

pills.label: Departs 19:30
pills.pop_html: Evening cruise, 2.5 hours. Boarding starts about 15 minutes before departure.Some tables are shared with other guests.

pills.label: Live jazz band
pills.pop_html: Three live sets with two breaks, and a different band most nights.This is a concert on the water, not a commentary cruise.

pills.label: 3-course dinner
pills.pop_html: With the dinner ticket (€80): Caprese salad, then salmon, vegetarian lasagne, pork tenderloin or chicken, then apple strudel or chocolate brownie.Pick your main course at checkout. Drinks are extra.

best_for.pick_html: for a night out: live jazz, dinner and the river in one booking.
best_for.skip_html: if you want sightseeing commentary or a cheap hour on the water.

items.q: Do I have to take the dinner?
items.a: No: €49 is the cruise and concert, €80 adds a 3-course dinner. You pick your main course at checkout.
Caprese salad, then salmon, vegetarian lasagne, pork tenderloin or chicken, then apple strudel or chocolate brownie.
No, drinks are ordered on board, even with the dinner ticket.

items.q: Is there commentary on the sights?
items.a: No. It is a concert on the water: three live jazz sets over 2.5 hours.
At 19:30, with boarding from about 15 minutes before. The exact pier is on your booking confirmation.

pills.pop_html: Fixed evening slot, 3 hours. Back on the pier around 22:00.

pills.pop_html: Sails on one of four glass-roofed boats: Grand Bohemia, Bohemia Rhapsody, Agnes de Bohemia or Anna Carolina.Middle seat €79, guaranteed window seat €99.

best_for.pick_html: for a relaxed 3-hour dinner with views from every table.

items.q: Is a window seat worth it?
items.a: It costs €20 more (€99 instead of €79). With glass all round, the middle seats lose less of the view than on an ordinary boat.
Hot and cold Czech and international dishes, salads and desserts, with vegetarian and vegan options. A welcome drink is included.
No, only the welcome drink. Other drinks are paid on board.
3 hours, the longest dinner cruise here: it leaves the Čech Bridge pier at 19:00 and is back around 22:00.
Yes, for free up to 72 hours before.
